entities.name: Non-semantical mandatory information element error
entities.description: A condition where a mandatory information element is received with non-semantical errors, such as incorrect format or structure violations.

entities.name: Mandatory information element
entities.description: An information element that must be present in a message according to protocol specifications.

entities.name: Error handling procedure
entities.description: The procedure followed when non-semantical errors are detected in mandatory information elements.

relations.description: The error handling procedure is triggered when non-semantical mandatory IE errors are detected.
Non-semantical errors are associated with mandatory information elements that contain structural or format violations.
